# The kernel command denominator: every command name the LaTeX2e unofficial
# reference manual indexes (@findex, @ftable items, @node headings), confirmed
# by lualatex to be a control sequence LaTeX defines, and classified by the
# meaning lualatex reports. Fields: name, manual chapter, lualatex meaning.
# A `math_given` row is a math-mode symbol command and a `not_base` row a
# command latex.ltx defines only as its "not provided in base LaTeX2e"
# error; both are excluded from the count and kept here so the exclusion
# is visible and countable. The
# confirmation runs under bare classes with no packages loaded, because under
# amsmath seven of those symbols are macros and the exclusion would then
# depend on what the confirmation happened to load.
# The manual is © its authors and permits verbatim and modified copies under
# its own notice; what is kept here is command names, chapter titles and
# lualatex meaning classes, and no prose.
# Regenerate with scripts/coverage.lean --denominator <latex2e.texi>; never
# hand-edit. The row count and body stamp below are checked by --check.
